findings.title: Unsigned short vector lengths underflow the SIMD loop bound
findings.evidence: size_t len is used in j <= len - 16; AVX512 repeats j <= len - 64 at line 63. No preceding lower-bound guard. Caller traced: 01_KISH_ENGINE/babylon60/transducers/void_vec.py:77-90 passes len(query) directly with no minimum or batch element length checks; pack_void_bit at 94-116 permits arbitrary dimensions padded only to 8 bits.
findings.trigger: Call exported NEON function with count > 0 and len < 16, or AVX512 function with len < 64.
findings.impact: With an accelerator shared library present, public Python void_batch_hamming_dist/void_hamming_dist accepts short packed vectors and reaches the underflowing C loop, causing out-of-bounds reads and potential process crash. No caller minimum-length constraint was found.

findings.title: Delete quarantine occurs before recoverable durable intent
findings.evidence: B::quarantine runs at 2126; first AttemptReserved WAL append is 2144. recover_quarantined at 2327 requires an existing WAL record.
findings.trigger: Crash or budget/WAL persistence failure after quarantine rename and before successful append_wal_record.
findings.impact: Original file has already moved, but recovery rejects the nonce for missing durable deletion intent; the documented recovery path cannot resolve that transaction.

findings.title: Delete uses two unconstrained nonce identities
findings.evidence: Quarantine basename uses tx_nonce; WAL entries use auth.nonce (2138); recovery constructs del_<nonce> from its WAL lookup nonce at 2347. No equality check in secure_delete_scoped.
findings.trigger: Caller supplies distinct nonzero auth.nonce and tx_nonce and deletion requires recovery after AttemptReserved.
findings.impact: Recovery looks up the authorized nonce successfully but probes a different quarantine filename and fails to recover the actual quarantined object.

findings.title: Zero-copy PoC reports success after dropped-message timeout
findings.evidence: The receive-count timeout breaks at 94-96; line 109 unconditionally prints FALSACION EMPIRICA SUPERADA. No final equality assertion or failing exit.
findings.trigger: Subscriber receives fewer than msg_count before timeout, or its receive loop exits on error.
findings.impact: PoC exits successfully and advertises empirical success despite incomplete delivery; allocation-free claims are also not measured here.

findings.title: Production dispatcher returns fabricated provider successes
findings.evidence: All three dispatch methods only asyncio.sleep then return SUCCESS and fixed result text; no provider call uses stored keys, URL, prompt or max_tokens. Header identifies Production Script.
findings.trigger: Use dispatcher for any plan/code/deep_context task.
findings.impact: Consumers receive successful provider/result records although no inference or code mutation occurred; misleading evidence if treated as production completion.

findings.title: Skill auditor passes when no skill directories exist
findings.evidence: Search roots are hardcoded ~/BABYLON-60/.agents/skills and ~/.gemini/config/skills (20-23); absent roots are skipped; empty files generates no errors and returns PASS.
findings.trigger: Run on a checkout elsewhere with neither legacy directory populated.
findings.impact: Quality gate reports 100% compliance for zero inspected skills, leaving the actual workspace skill library unchecked.

findings.title: Webhook example consumes request body twice
findings.evidence: Line 29 awaits request.text() for signature verification; line 32 awaits request.text() again for JSON. Request body is single-use; MDN Request.text documents TypeError for disturbed/locked body: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Request/text
findings.trigger: Valid signed webhook with a body using the provided handler.
findings.impact: Second body read rejects before queueing; valid events fail rather than returning 202. Cache the first text and parse it.

findings.title: Cross-instance effect budget uses stale usage history
findings.evidence: new loads .budget_usage.bin into usage_history once (1352-1364). acquire_hybrid_resource_gate invokes refresh_nonce_state_locked (1433), which reloads only consumed nonces and effect WAL (1438-1481), never usage_history. verify_budget_allowed reads the cached usage map (1640-1662); commit_budget_usage updates only its local map and appends usage records.
findings.trigger: Create two orchestrators on the same root before either consumes a max_effects=1 policy for the same principal/epoch; provision that policy in both and execute separate authorized effects with distinct nonces.
findings.impact: The global flock serializes effects but each instance sees its own zero usage, so both can pass a one-effect budget. Durable history records the overrun only after effects are performed.

findings.title: Mutation receipt recovery does not restore charged budget
findings.evidence: secure_mutate_scoped performs backend mutation at 2273 before commit_budget_usage at 2295. reconcile_wal_entry recognizes post_hash and persists OutcomeKnown at 1922-1938 without updating usage_history or .budget_usage.bin; WalRecord lacks principal identity.
findings.trigger: Crash after successful mutation before commit_budget_usage, then restart and reconcile the AttemptReserved mutation whose on-disk bytes match post_hash.
findings.impact: Recovery confirms the effect while leaving the principal budget uncharged, allowing subsequent distinct-nonce effects to exceed the configured total.

tool_limitations: No native codebase-memory graph tools exposed (ALL_TOOLS inspection); targeted text fallback used.
